evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies AddrMan logic in src/addrman.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a logic error where AddrMan's timestamp check fails to account for the stored 2h time penalty, falsely inflating an address's multiplicity in the new table up to 8 on identical announcements. The fix improves AddrMan table correctness, though the author notes it does not significantly change adversarial resilience since an attacker can simply vary timestamps.
